scope: Targeted assistant trace and answer review, not independent human gold

gateReview.reason: The frozen gate requires preserving L01, a previously successful control. Normal L01 retrieves a later 142-second street bench and calls it the initial waiting place, rather than the initial underground platform. Do not relax the gate after observing the regression.

cases.normal: Wrong first-place binding despite actual memory search; cited memory-v143 is a later outdoor scene
cases.memoryDisabled: Cannot recall initial bench without old memory
cases.suppliedEvidence: Correct station bench after old platform image is supplied
cases.diagnosis: Retrieval/ranking and earliest-target resolution dominate this example; persistence is present, recall selects the wrong event

cases.normal: Now retrieves the early second-store interior and describes pale counters
cases.suppliedEvidence: Describes the early pale display counters
cases.diagnosis: Positive evidence that enabling retrieval can help a historical fact, not a general accuracy guarantee

cases.normal: Claims restaurant and laundromat are the same shop because of checkerboard flooring
cases.suppliedEvidence: Recognizes repeated hardware-store layout from the two supplied old images
cases.diagnosis: Candidate evidence selection and identity reasoning are inadequate; common decor is not instance identity. Oracle also supplies temporal/referent anchors, so this is not a pure retrieval-only intervention

cases.normal: Retrieves a hardware facade sign and substitutes it for the wall near the interior counter
cases.suppliedEvidence: Identifies the noticeboard near the counter
cases.diagnosis: Right general place, wrong subregion/object. Retrieval occurrence alone is insufficient

cases.normal: Recalls green tabletop using old memory
cases.diagnosis: Reference wording most conspicuous countertop can refer to multiple visible surfaces; do not automatically classify the oracle difference as perception failure

cases.normal: Recalls two seating scenes using memory and attempts comparison
cases.suppliedEvidence: Describes both scenes but reverses which is the earlier restaurant and later cafe
cases.diagnosis: Historical referent/time-to-image binding can fail even with sufficient old images

cases.normal: Locates the visible right-hand doorway without direct permission to walk through
cases.diagnosis: The specific prior unsafe addition did not recur in this trial; this does not certify general safety

cases.normal: Asks which device the user means
cases.diagnosis: This intervention resolves referent ambiguity as well as exposing pixels. A reasonable clarification is not necessarily hallucination, but it does not complete the single-turn task

cases.normal: Selects terrace door rather than upper elevator-landing wood door
cases.diagnosis: The vague phrase just arrived upstairs has multiple real referents. Original unique private timestamp must not be blindly treated as the only valid interpretation

automaticReviewLimitations: Some ordinary answers and many supplied-image answers failed quote/evidence validators. Their stored utility zero is an unreviewed placeholder, not a certified wrong-answer score.
The automated judge still gave memory-disabled L16 full credit for inability to confirm an answerable old color question; do not use automatic ablation aggregates as reliable accuracy.

Oracle raw images were sometimes wrongly cited by the judge as persistent-memory evidence and correctly rejected by validators. This is grading failure, not evidence that the oracle answer itself was wrong.
The failed L01 control and the unsupported restaurant/laundromat identity claim establish that expansion gates are not met independently of those grading failures.
decision: Pilot not accepted for full90 expansion. Preserve both attempts, calibrated automated reviews and this targeted review. Remaining work needs stronger temporal/visit evidence binding, not higher concurrency or a claim that tools are now sufficient.
